name: huffmandict
expr: [d, av] = huffmandict(syms, ps); [d2, av2] = huffmandict([0 1], [0.7 0.3]); [d3, av3] = huffmandict([1 2 3 4], uni);
comment: MATLAB huffmandict: Huffman code-book builder. Codes are NOT unique (tie-breaking yields different but equally optimal trees) -- the invariant is avglen = sum(p_k * L_k). Fingerprint pins avglen on three test cases (5-symbol skewed, 2-symbol, 4-symbol uniform). Code shape, prefix-freeness and bounds H <= avglen < H+1 covered in gtest. Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship huffmandict in core (signal/communications package only); reports N/A.
